# Fleet Maintenance Policy 2025

> **Source:** `inbox/Fleet Maintenance Policy 2025.docx` · **Type:** Word document · Converted to Markdown by the OTO extraction pipeline.

## Fleet Maintenance Policy 2025
## Purpose
This policy sets how Northwind Transit keeps its bus fleet safe and in service. It applies to every Bus in the fleet and to every Garage that maintains one.
## Roles
The Fleet Manager owns this policy and approves every change to the PM Schedule.
The Maintenance Supervisor at each Garage assigns Work Orders to technicians and closes them once the Inspection passes.
The Safety Officer reviews every Incident Report within five working days.
## Preventive Maintenance
Every Bus follows the PM Schedule. A missed PM interval opens a Work Order automatically.

| PM level | Interval | Performed at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PM-A | every 6,000 km | any Garage |
| PM-B | every 24,000 km | Central Garage |
| PM-C | every 96,000 km | Central Garage |

## Work Orders
A Work Order names the Bus, the Garage, the fault and the parts used. A Work Order raised after an Incident Report cites it.
Effective 2025-01-15. Supersedes the 2022 maintenance procedure.
